description: This file defines the CreateDatasetPage class, a page object model for automating interactions with the dataset creation page in the Superset frontend, using Playwright for browser automation.

classes.name: CreateDatasetPage
classes.description: Page object for the dataset creation wizard, providing methods to interact with form elements and navigate the page.

methods.name: getDatabaseSelect
methods.description: Returns a Select object for the database dropdown.

methods.name: getSchemaSelect
methods.description: Returns a Select object for the schema dropdown.

methods.name: getTableSelect
methods.description: Returns a Select object for the table dropdown.

methods.name: getCreateAndExploreButton
methods.description: Returns a Button object for the 'Create and explore dataset' button.

methods.name: goto
methods.description: Navigates to the dataset creation page.

methods.name: selectDatabase
methods.description: Selects a database from the dropdown by name.

methods.name: selectSchema
methods.description: Selects a schema from the dropdown by name.

methods.name: selectTable
methods.description: Selects a table from the dropdown by name.

methods.name: clickCreateDataset
methods.description: Clicks the 'Create dataset' option from the dropdown menu.

methods.name: clickCreateAndExploreDataset
methods.description: Clicks the 'Create and explore dataset' button.

methods.name: waitForPageLoad
methods.description: Waits for the page to load by ensuring the database selector is visible.
